usage: Inda (印度 jan3 dou6) is used as a proper noun to refer to the country India.
It is often used with verbs like '去' (heoi3, to go), '嚟' (lai4, to come), or phrases indicating origin or nationality.
You can use 印度 to talk about culture, travel, or food related to India.
印 度 is mostly used in contexts involving geography, nationality, or international topics.
